name: specular-button

frames.best_why: The sheen is at its brightest, wrapping the tinted button's rim while both labels stay readable.

tagline: Dark glass buttons with a bright sheen that follows the cursor around the rim.
summary: A pair of rounded glass buttons on black. A specular highlight and faint glow travel along the button's edge toward the pointer, brightening as it approaches and easing back to a dim idle shine.
appearance: Two rounded rectangles sit side by side on a black field. The left is near-black glass with a thin grey rim and a white "Get started" label; the right is tinted deep indigo with a violet rim and a lighter "Book a demo" label. Both carry soft outer shadows and a faint light streak along part of the border.
behaviour: The rim sheen slides around the edge to face the cursor and the button brightens as the pointer nears, from about 250px away. Pressing adds a stronger shine that then fades, and when the pointer leaves the light eases to a dim idle spot.
demo_content: Two buttons labelled "Get started" (dark) and "Book a demo" (indigo tint).
search_phrases: glass button with light on the edge
frosted glass call to action button
premium black button with rim light
use_when: A dark or premium landing page needs a call to action that reacts to the cursor without leaving the page.
avoid_when: The glow is a WebGL canvas, and the fixed pale text needs a dark surrounding surface to stay legible.
customise: The label is children. Size, radius, tint, tint opacity, blur, text, line and base colours, sheen size, thickness, glow, speed and mouse following are props; the shader itself is fixed.
weight_why: A WebGL fragment shader that only redraws while the sheen moves or the pointer is near.

a11y.note: A native button with a visible focus ring and real label text. Reduced motion stops auto-animate, but the pointer sheen still moves.

polish_why: The rim light reads convincingly under the cursor; at rest the two buttons are very faint on black.
title: Specular Button
